messages:
Iris Park: Hi all  quick weird one on day 1. I can log into Okta, but the profile shows my email as iris.p@redwood.com (missing the 'ark') and 1Password invite bounced back as undeliverable. Not sure if my corporate alias messed up during provisioning. Anyone seen alias truncation like this? :thinking:
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning record: okta_user_created iris.park@redwood.com at 2026-07-08T14:02:11Z; google_account_provision_attempted for iris.park@redwood.com at 2026-07-08T14:02:40Z; alert: email_bounce detected for 1password_invite to iris.park@redwood.com
Priya Patel: Welcome Iris! Sorry about the noise. Two checks: 1) In Okta go to Settings -> Profile and paste a screenshot of the primary email field. 2) Do you have any email forwarding or alias configured that could cause delivery to bounce?
Iris Park: Okta profile screenshot pasted: it shows "email: iris.p@redwood.com" and "alternateEmail: iris.park+personal@gmail.com". I don't have forwarding set. I think the primary is wrong.
Samir Rao: Sounds like a CSV truncation from our HR sync where the last name column got trimmed for a small batch. Priya, we had a mapping patch last week that touched displayName/email concatenation. We should be able to correct it and re-trigger downstream invites.
Priya Patel: Yup, I can fix the Okta profile to iris.park@redwood.com and then requeue the 1Password invite. I'll also kick the Google mailbox create job again. Doing the fix now  will update when done.
DevOps Bot: Action: updated Okta profile for iris.park@redwood.com; requeued 1Password invite; Google mailbox create retried. Change recorded in IT audit at 2026-07-08T14:08:05Z.
Iris Park: Thanks! After the fix, will Drive/team shares become visible automatically or do I need to be re-added to groups?
Priya Patel: If your groups were created based on the wrong email, I may need to add you manually to the team groups (eng-infra). I'll check group membership and add you if missing. Also, if Drive still shows 403 after the add try incognito/hard refresh.
Samir Rao: Also note GitHub invites are keyed off the canonical email on the Okta profile. Once Priya fixes it you should get the org invite. If you don't in 10m ping #platform and we'll trigger a resend.
Iris Park: DevOps Bot DMed me the new 1Password link and mailbox create shows success now. Okta profile fixed  I can access Drive after a quick incognito. One last MFA question: I prefer security keys (YubiKey). Anything I should do differently for corporate provisioning?
Priya Patel: Good choice. In Okta go to Profile -> Extra Verification Methods -> Add Passkey. On macOS Chrome make sure to allow USB/passkey device prompt and disable extensions if you hit a prompt race. If the passkey flow still errors, enroll TOTP first to unblock and we'll reset passkey state for you. Save backup codes too.
Iris Park: Great, passkey enrolled on my YubiKey. Also received GitHub invite and added SSH key. For reference I used:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "iris.park@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Iris Park: All good now  thanks everyone for the quick triage! :tada:
